name: Always Has Been
look: A 3D render of two astronauts in space looking at Earth against a starry sky. The nearer one, with a US flag patch, gazes at the planet while a second astronaut, wearing an Ohio flag patch, stands behind him pointing a handgun at his back.
use: The first astronaut realizes something, captioned as Wait, it's all...?, and the armed astronaut behind him replies Always has been, confirming the uncomfortable truth was there all along.
slots: the realization, Wait, it's all...? (by the first astronaut)
Always has been (by the astronaut with the gun)
examples: Wait, it's all meetings that could have been emails?
Wait, every recipe starts with a life story?
